messages:
elaine: FYI support ticket stack — several customers reporting per-model throughput charts showing no series since ~0400 UTC. They see "no data" in Console panels but API metrics and model traffic look normal from their end. pinging eng.
john: Thanks, Elaine. Can you paste one example customer dashboard link + any error the console shows?
elaine: Customer: acme-inc. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/abcd123/models?org=acme-inc (sent privately). No console error, panels just render as empty lines. Screenshot attached in ticket.
sofia: Is the backend ingestion still scraping exporter endpoints? If Prometheus didn't scrape, panels would be empty.
tom: I checked Prometheus: targets UP, scrape_latency ok. But a quick query shows no series for redwood_inference_qps by label "model":
```
# prometheus
count by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_qps[1m]))
```
returns 0 series.
john: Huh. Did we do any metric renames in the deploy earlier? I remember a metrics schema refactor landed in the runtime PR last night. @sofia?
sofia: Yes we merged runtime:metrics-schema-refactor (PR #2935) at 02:20 UTC. It renamed label key model -> model_id and changed a couple metric names (request_count -> requests_total). We tried to keep compatibility but maybe missed dashboards/recording rules.
li: Several paying customers sent escalations saying throughput went to zero in Console (billing unaffected). They're asking for ETA.
elaine: Can we get a quick mitigation? Customers expect graphs back ASAP even if it's a workaround.
sofia: Two mitigation paths: 1) Quick: update Grafana templating + queries to accept model_id or model (use label_replace or regex) — low-risk change to dashboards. 2) Longer: add a shim in exporter/runtime to emit both labels (model and model_id) for backward compatibility, then revert dashboards. Which do we prefer?
john: Do dashboards live in infra repo? Is there a configuration that we can patch and redeploy quickly?
tom: Dashboards are templated via config in infra/grafana/dashboards. We can apply a hotfix that uses label regex in panels and push a config update. I can prepare a patch.
sofia: Also check recording rules: we have some recording rules that aggregate by model; those are keyed on the old label and now empty. Updating dashboards alone might not help if panels reference recordings. Need to inspect.
john: Action items: Tom to send a hotfix PR for dashboards; Sofia to add a small compatible recording rule fallback or update rules; I'll coordinate with Deploy to push a fast rollout. Elaine to reply to customers and set expectation.
elaine: I'll send a templated message: "We’re aware of an analytics console issue affecting per-model throughput visuals due to an internal metrics schema update. We’re rolling a fix and expect dashboards to be restored within ~30–60m."
sofia: Quick reproduction steps I ran: curl exporter metrics -> grep sample shows label name changed: 
```
# before (old exporter)
redwood_inference_qps{model="rwd/medium-v2",instance="g1"} 12.3
# now (new)
redwood_inference_qps{model_id="rwd/medium-v2",instance="g1"} 12.3
```
So the series still exists but under different label key.
john: Tom, can you include an or-clause in Grafana queries e.g. label_replace(redwood_inference_qps, "model", "$1", "model_id", "(.*)")? Or use query that aggregates over both labels.
tom: Yup. I'll open PR: infra#grafana-hotfix-482. Patch will: update panel queries to coalesce model/model_id, and update template variable query to return model names from either label. Also update any recording rule references to use the new helper rules.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra-grafana-config/hotfix/482 -> staging at 04:35 UTC
sofia: I'll also push a small recording rules patch to add rules like: 
```
record: redwood:requests:rate:by_model
expr: coalesce(
  sum by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_qps[5m])),
  sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_inference_qps[5m]))
)
```
This keeps a single series available for dashboards.
john: Good. After staging verification, push to prod. Notify customers when done.
deploy-bot: deploy success: infra-grafana-config/hotfix/482 -> prod at 04:46 UTC
tom: Panels are showing series again for acme-inc in prod, confirmed. Recording rule fallback also created in prometheus-rules (applied).
elaine: Notified affected customers: ACME, BetaLabs, FinSight. All replied they see charts restored.
li: Logged postmortem ticket: OPS-4282 (metrics-schema-change caused analytics break). Need follow-up: add backwards-compatibility policy for label renames.
sofia: Plan: exporter will be updated to emit both label keys for a 2-week compatibility window, then we'll schedule a deprecation. I'll open runtime PR to add dual labels.
john: Thanks all. Quick retrospective: require dashboard + recording rule review in metrics refactor PR checklist.
elaine: Closing the support escalation now. If anything else crops up, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:
